description: Regional overlay. Adds delivery information ('how and where') against national criteria actions. By design an overlay may only carry title, description and documentation against an existing national action id; it cannot carry conditions, inputs, or a library reference, and the build rejects one that does. Content here is illustrative placeholder text.
